title: Concurrent withdrawals lose updates
diff: throw new Error("amount must be positive");
-    "UPDATE wallets SET balance = balance - $1 WHERE user_id = $2 AND balance >= $1 RETURNING balance",
+  if (current < amount) throw new Error("insufficient funds");
+  await db.query("UPDATE wallets SET balance = $1 WHERE user_id = $2",

ground_truth.explanation: Replacing the atomic decrement with read-then-write lets two concurrent withdrawals both read the same balance and one update is silently lost.
